sections.Profile:
"King Rock" and "King Kool" are two pinball machines released by Gottlieb in 1972, designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison. "King Rock" is the four-player version, and "King Kool" is the two-player version of the same game. Both machines are electro-mechanical, featuring four flippers, three pop bumpers, and two spinning targets, providing a classic pinball experience.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1972
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
